case_number: 2025 INSC 394; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@Special Leave Petition (C) No.12459 of 2019)

parties.respondent: The Oriental Insurance Company Ltd & Ors.

summary: Motor accident claim under Section 166, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988; preponderance of probability standard; insurer failed to plead contributory negligence before Tribunal; police charge-sheeted trailer driver for rash/negligent driving; High Court erred in relying on unexamined written statement of scooter owner; mere possession of learner's licence does not establish negligence; negligence primarily on trailer driver; compensation enhanced; interest awarded.
legal_provisions_cited: Sunita v. Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation
Dulcina Fernandes v. Joaquim Xavier Cruz
Mangla Ram v. Oriental Insurance Company Limited
Sudhir Kumar Rana v. Surinder Singh
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation enhanced; 60% liability on insurer upheld; interest awarded; High Court findings on contributory negligence set aside.
